abilities.name: magnet-pull
abilities.effect: Prevents steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.

abilities.name: sturdy
abilities.effect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead.  Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

abilities.name: analytic
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.

kanto.flavorText: Uses antigravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

original-johto.flavorText: The electricity emitted by the units on each side of its body cause it to become a strong magnet.

hoenn.flavorText: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.

updated-johto.flavorText: The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.

original-unova.flavorText: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.

updated-unova.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

kalos.flavorText: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Magnemite floats in the air by emitting electromagnetic waves from the units at its sides. These waves block gravity. This Pokémon becomes incapable of flight if its internal electrical supply is depleted.

original-alola.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it’s eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

updated-alola.flavorText: Perhaps because electrical lines are often buried these days, the number of Magnemite attacks on power plants has increased.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: It is hatched with the ability to defy gravity. It floats while emitting powerful electromagnetic waves.

swsh.flavorText: It subsists on electricity. As Magnemite flies, it emits electromagnetic waves from the units on each side of its body.

pla.flavorText: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.
